credits.title: Upiro
credits.overview: Spain, 1755. Ana is sent to a cloistered monastery where several nuns are afflicted by a mysterious  disease. With the help of an unorthodox priest, the young novice uncovers an ancient legend and  malevolent force: a bloodthirsty upiro.

credits.title: From Good to the Hood
credits.overview: Cheating the tax man was just too tempting for Andrés. Besides, what are the chances of him getting caught? Well, as it turns out, pretty high! And that’s exactly what happens when a couple of tax inspectors turn up at his company to inform him that he owes the IRS a lot of money.

credits.title: Sounds Like Love
credits.overview: Fashion assistant Maca has just about got her life together after a devastating breakup, when Leo, the man who broke her heart returns. Seeking support from best friends, Adriana and Jime, all three will learn love can be complicated.
